briefdescription.para: Persist the complete adapter state to a binary checkpoint file.

detaileddescription.para:
The file format is self-describing:
8-byte magic ("ADALORA\0")
4-byte uint32 version (currently 1)
64-byte model fingerprint (SHA-256 hex, NUL-padded)
4-byte uint32 layer count
For each layer (in insertion order):
4-byte uint32 name length
name bytes (UTF-8, no NUL)
8-byte uint64 in_dim, out_dim, max_rank, active_rank
4-byte float alpha, importance
B matrix: (in_dim × max_rank) float32 values
A matrix: (max_rank × out_dim) float32 values

parameterdescription.para: Destination file path (parent directory must exist).
Optional SHA-256 fingerprint of the base model (64 hex chars); stored in the header for cache invalidation. Empty string stores all-zero bytes.

briefdescription.para: Restore adapter state from a binary checkpoint file.

briefdescription.para: Check whether a saved checkpoint is still valid for the given model.

current_fingerprint

true — checkpoint exists and fingerprint matches (no rebuild needed).
